subject: Novapay MAP: Gateplaybook & close roadmap (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)
messages:
From: Aliya Khan <aliya.khan@novapay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@novapay.com, procurement@novapay.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Novapay MAP kickoff — security gates & close runway

Connor / Marissa — thanks for onboarding the team. We need a mutual action plan (MAP) that clearly calls out the security/compliance gates, ownership, and a realistic close timeline for our pilot and GA stages. High-level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 evidence and expected delivery windows (system description, control matrix, recent attestation)
- SIG/CAIQ completion schedule and a point person for technical Q&A
- DPA redlines we expect to negotiate; procurement needs a draft and a target sign date
- Data retention & residency options (we may require EU data residency for a subset of logs)

Can you share a short gateplaybook (owners + dates) and a working MAP spreadsheet we can iterate on? We are targeting a pilot contract signed by the end of October if the security bar is met. If any of these timelines are unrealistic, call that out so we can align procurement.

Also copying our security lead (security@novapay.com) and procurement.

Thanks,
Aliya
Aliya Khan
CTO, NovaPay

P.S. Proc team prefers DocuSign for final contracts — sending procurement contact in a follow-up if needed.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Khan <aliya.khan@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay MAP kickoff — security gates & close runway

Aliya — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass gateplaybook and MAP workbook (Novapay_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed owners, acceptance criteria, and target dates. Top-level summary below: 

MAP summary (proposed) — pilot close target: 2026-10-28
- SOC 2: supply current attestation + control evidence by 2026-10-05. Owner: Marissa Cole (Security Liaison). Acceptance: validated attestation + sampling of control artifacts (access logs, change control, incident response runbook).
- SIG/CAIQ: technical questionnaire draft returned by 2026-09-22, completed answers + follow-up calls by 2026-10-08. Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer).
- DPA: Redwood will send redline by 2026-09-15; target negotiation complete & signature-ready by 2026-10-20. Owner: Legal (cc'ed via Ben for intake).
- Data retention/residency: propose two tracks — hosted US (default) + EU residency for log subset. Decision due 2026-09-20. Owner: Connor O'Brien (PM).
- Acceptance gate: mutual sign-off on SOC 2 & DPA + SIG Q&A closed. Fallback: temporary restrictive rate-limited pilot if minor items remain (documented in MAP).

Action items I need from NovaPay this week:
1) Confirm whether EU residency is a hard requirement for pilot logs or a future ask.
2) Provide a list of must-have evidences for procurement to mark as blockers.
3) Confirm procurement contact & DocuSign preference.

I've attached the MAP workbook — it contains a milestone tab, evidence owner tab, and a short risk register. If that looks good I'll run a 30-min kickoff with your security and procurement next Tue 9/15 (slots at 9:00 or 14:00 PT).

Attachments: Novapay_MAP_v1.xlsx

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0104

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Khan <aliya.khan@novapay.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: 2026-09-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay MAP kickoff — security gates & close runway

Aliya / Connor — quick technical notes to supplement Connor's MAP spreadsheet (see inline). I pulled the latest items from our compliance team: 

- SOC 2 evidence availability: SOC 2 Type II attestation (report date: 2026-03-30) available now; control artifact bundles (access logs, IAM change log, IR tabletop notes) can be staged in a shared folder by 2026-09-23. Owner: Marissa Cole.
- SIG/CAIQ: Ben will own the questionnaire and run a 45-min walkthrough with your infra/security team the week of 9/27. Expected completion 2026-10-08.
- DPA redlines: attached a starting set (DPA_Redlines.docx). We usually accept a subset of limited liability carveouts but will flag high-risk clauses for legal review. Expect initial one-pass redline to you by 2026-09-15.
- Data retention/residency: for pilot we can offer EU residency for ingestion + logs using our EU-dedicated pipeline (adds ~2 weeks to onboarding). If EU residency is required for the pilot, we should mark that as a critical path item and push some infra setup actions to 9/16-9/30.

I attached the SOC2 attestation PDF stub and the DPA redline doc for procurement to look at. 

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm EU residency requirement by 2026-09-15 (NovaPay)
- Kickoff call: Tue 2026-09-15 14:00 PT (preferred) — I'll run through SOC 2 artifacts and a SIG walkthrough plan
- Procurement: please review DPA_Redlines.docx and send any must-have contractual language back by 2026-09-18

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-Attestation.pdf (stub), DPA_Redlines.docx

From: Aliya Khan <aliya.khan@novapay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, security@novapay.com, procurement@novapay.com
Date: 2026-09-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay MAP kickoff — security gates & close runway

Thanks — this is helpful and close to what we need. A couple clarifications before the kickoff: 

1) EU residency — for the pilot we need logs for European customers (PII-derived telemetry) to be stored in-region; this is a hard requirement. Can you confirm whether the EU pipeline requires any third-party approvals or keys we need to present to InfoSec?

2) SOC 2 evidence — procurement will perform a high-level read; our security team will ask for a short window to run a sample validation. Can Marissa hold evidence in a folder with read-only links by 9/23 as proposed?

3) DPA — procurement spotted one high-risk clause (section 7, liability cap language). We want your legal to propose language that limits our liability exposure in line with market norms — if that requires exec approval we'll need that flagged in the MAP.

I've accepted the 9/15 14:00 PT kickoff slot. Procurement would prefer DocuSign for contract signing (procurement@novapay.com). I'll loop in our lead infra contact in a separate note.

DocuSign request: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-novapay (procurement link)

See you Tue.

Aliya
Aliya Khan
CTO, NovaPay
